title: PowerMarketJax: A JAX Benchmark Suite for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Power Markets
abstract: arXiv:2609.37321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Power markets are a natural testbed for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), where multiple self-interested participants repeatedly submit bids. A market-clearing mechanism then determines dispatch and prices subject to power grid constraints and market settlement rules. However, existing MARL environments typically focus on a single market setting, implement simplified clearing mechanisms, or rely on CPU-based optimization solvers that slow large-scale training and limit the systematic study of bidding strategies and market behavior. We introduce PowerMarketJax, a benchmark suite for MARL across five power markets: day-ahead wholesale, real-time balancing, ancillary services, peer-to-peer double auctions, and local flexibility. translated_title: PowerMarketJax：面向电力市场多智能体强化学习的JAX基准测试套件
translated_abstract: 电力市场是多智能体强化学习（MARL）的天然试验场，其中多个自利的参与者反复提交报价，随后市场出清机制在电网约束和市场结算规则下确定调度和价格。然而，现有的MARL环境通常只关注单一市场场景、采用简化的出清机制，或依赖基于CPU的优化求解器，这拖慢了大规模训练的速度，并限制了对竞价策略和市场行为的系统性研究。我们提出了PowerMarketJax，一个覆盖五种电力市场的MARL基准测试套件：日前批发市场、实时平衡市场、辅助服务市场、点对点双向拍卖市场以及本地灵活性市场。每个环境都实现了各自的出清、定价和结算规则，同时为学习与评估提供了统一框架。我们发现，学习到的竞价行为高度依赖于市场（机制）设计……
tldr: PowerMarketJax是一个基于JAX的多智能体强化学习基准套件，涵盖五种电力市场环境并实现各自的出清、定价与结算规则，为高效大规模研究竞价策略和市场行为提供了统一平台。
